SELECT o1_0.id, o1_0.address, o1_0.city, o1_0.first_name, o1_0.last_name, o1_0.telephone
FROM owners o1_0
WHERE o1_0.last_name like ? escape '\'
ORDER BY o1_0.first_name, o1_0.last_name, o1_0.id
FETCH FIRST ? rows only
